remarks: Fine workmanship. Each inner slide tube cut down by approx. 210mm, so the instrument can be played only to fourth position. Slide stays have oblique stripes.⁵  [****check Van der Meer on shape of slide-stays.] Twenty-one ferrules with dragon-scale pattern: six attaching various parts of bell-section, two on either end of slide-bow, two one either end of bell-bow, ten adjacent to slide-stays.⁶  Flat bell stay engraved with tulip, a six-petal flower, another flower, tendrils;⁷  fastened on one side with hinge, on the other side with a seven-sided sleeve decorated with stripes.⁸  Slide-bow and bell-bow have simple rings mounted on saddles, the saddles engraved with zigzag pattern. Garland is attached to bell; toothed proximal border on garland; simple rim-wire.⁹  Letters of signature are hatched, date is simply engraved.¹⁰  Due to many cracks in bell and bell-pipe, instrument not playable.
